correctness.rationale: For the full space the nonzero exponential factors leave exactly the three roots of x³−12x²+36x−24 as admissible scaled squared separations. The root sign brackets and equilateral realizations give existence. The monic irreducible polynomial gives the presentation of Z[1/2,u], and the certified cyclic transforms give all three roots in that ring. A planar four-point configuration has zero Cayley–Menger determinant; evaluation u↦29 mod 53 would preserve zero. Independent symbolic reduction and modular Gaussian elimination on full 5×5 Cayley–Menger matrices verified the same 729 nonzero cases and bins 233,211,215,70. Every larger set contains a four-point subset. For full order three, write r²=(3−√3)/α and take the origin and three points on the radius-r circle with successive angular gaps 150°,150°,60°; the squared distance ratio of the long chord to r is 2+√3, so all six separations are allowed. The nesting comparison concerns different normalized evaluation representers and functional norms in nested subspaces; the Gaussian norm of a function is unchanged under inclusion.
residual_risks: No claim for a single true level, higher complex dimension, or approximate orthogonality. The bibliographic item [3] is a catalog finding, not independently attested as a conventional journal publication.
